teaser: WSO2 Agent Manager reviewed as a partner: what is open source, how its layers fit, and an MVP plugging behaviour policies in.
core_idea: WSO2 Agent Manager is an open control plane for agents: an identity per agent, an Envoy gateway on every model and MCP call with guardrails, a Kubernetes runtime with isolation tiers, and OpenTelemetry traces. Its code is Apache 2.0 and free to run; the supported build, updates, support and SaaS are paid. In a company that has deployed it, Agent Behaviour Policies add the mandate at the gateway through its interceptor policy, Process Behaviour Policies add kernel enforcement as another runtime tier, and both decisions can be recorded in the same trace. A five-step MVP on WSO2's quick start would prove it.
